cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: Walk the harbor foreshore for views of the Opera House and Harbour Bridge.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: Explore neighborhood cafés, galleries, and street art in Melbourne’s laneways.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: Follow Tokyo’s rail lines from busy shopping streets to quiet neighborhood shrines.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: Discover temple gardens and traditional teahouses in Japan’s former capital.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: Ride up Sugarloaf Mountain for a view of the city and the surrounding bays.

cities.name: São Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: Explore market stalls and museums in Brazil’s largest city.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: See the Khmer temple’s carved galleries and five towers near Siem Reap.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: Visit the Mughal garden complex in Agra and see its white marble mausoleum.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: Paddle across a turquoise lagoon and look back toward Mount Otemanu.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: Follow Copacabana’s wave-patterned promenade along Rio’s Atlantic coast.
